Welcome to the Icon of the Alps

Discover the Iconic. Rewarding. Spectacular spirit of the Alps!

Ready for an adventure of a lifetime? The Swiss Epic is calling your name! Each year, we carve out an exciting new route, showcasing stunning mountain passes, flow trails, bike parks, and picturesque valleys. Join riders from around the world to explore Graubünden’s charming alpine towns, compete alongside pros, and enjoy top-notch Swiss hospitality. Create unforgettable memories on some of the world’s best mountain bike trails. 

The Alps are calling. Get ready. The 2027 Swiss Epic is coming!

Registrations Opening Soon!

Get ready to conquer the Alps like never before. The adventure of a lifetime is just around the corner challenging trails, breathtaking views, and the thrill of pushing your limits. Stay tuned, secure your spot, and prepare to rise above the peaks.

This is your chance to test yourself on Europe’s ultimate Alpine stage.
Your journey starts soon. Limited Entries available:

  • Priority Early Bird Registration opens at 12:00 CET, 1 September 2025 for 24 hours – limited to 25 teams.
  • General Early Bird Registration opens at 12:00 CET, 2 September 2025 for 48 hours – limited entries available.

This is it. Swiss Epic is here. Riders from around the world have arrived in Graubünden, ready to carve through mountain passes, flow trails, bike parks, and picturesque valleys on this year's route. Race alongside the pros, explore the region's charming alpine towns, and experience Swiss hospitality at its best.

The Alps are calling. Follow the race and see who's ready to #ConquerTheAlps!
